描述_EN: bushell was a physician by profession, but his 30-year-long residence in beijing had made him a self-taught expert. bushell was a physician by profession, but his 30-year- long residence in beijing had made him a self-taught expert. the ceramics bushell selected on behalf of the museum included blue-and-white and colour-enamelled wares, which were fashionable in the late 19th century. but he did not overlook the more subtle monochromes which were, a few decades later, much appreciated by collectors and connoisseurs. six-character mark on base in underglaze blue. the dish painted with flowers in enamel colours is generally referred to as 'famille rose' porcelain, due to the predominance of the pink colour. the flowers carry over the rim from outside to inside. dish made of porcelain painted with overglaze enamels in the famille rose palette, depicting peonies, chrysanthemums, grasses and dragon-fly. he made several acquisitions on behalf of the v&a and in 1898 was commissioned by the board of education to write a comprehensive book on chinese art, which has been reprinted several times. it was one of the v&a's early purchases of chinese art through the good offices of dr stephen wootton bushell (1844-1908).
描述_ZN: Bushell的职业是医生，但他在北京居住了30年，使他成为自学成才的专家。 Bushell的职业是医生，但他在北京长达30年的居住使他成为一个自学成才的专家。 布舍尔代表博物馆选择的陶瓷包括19世纪末流行的蓝白和彩色珐琅器皿。 但他并没有忽视更微妙的单色，这些单色在几十年后受到了收藏家和鉴赏家的青睐。 底有釉里红六字款。 该盘以珐琅彩绘花，一般被称为 "粉彩 "瓷器，因为粉色占主导地位。 花从外面到里面的边缘都有。 盘子由瓷器制成，用釉上彩在粉彩调色板上绘画，描绘了牡丹、菊花、草和蜻蜓。 他代表V&A进行了几次收购，并在1898年受教育委员会的委托写了一本关于中国艺术的综合书，该书已被多次重印。 这是V&A早期通过Stephen Wootton Bushell博士（1844-1908）的斡旋购买的中国艺术品之一。
